positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lockheed Martin's Information Systems and Global Solutions aquired by Leidos in Aug 2016 (same continuous employment from start with LM in 2007)
  o ServiceNow Developer and Administrator
  o Support company-wide site where users come for help desk issues, service requests, hardware/software requests, etc.

positions.title: Software Configuration Analyst
positions.description:
• Info. Systems & Global Solutions (2009 – Aug 2016)
  o Software Configuration Management team
  o Served as Administrator of applications in various systems: Ticketing, Reporting Repository, Account Provisioning
  o Oracle PeopleSoft Security Administrator
  o MS SharePoint Administrator and Help Stream support member
  o Reviewed and assigned production change tickets
  o Coordinated promotions to production environments
  o As Project Lead, led successful upgrade project of critical Reporting Repository accessed by 1200 users
  o Designed and supported Help Desk for Financial Systems users
  o Took proactive approach to streamline various processes
• Enterprise Business Services (2007 – 2009)
  o Performed maintenance and deployments to test and production environments
  o Performed software content audits on supported applications

positions.title: Intercollegiate Athletics Communications Intern
positions.description:
• Maintained Penn State’s sports website, GoPSUSports.com, using HTML and FTP software
• Edited and formatted media guides for various sports
• Compiled sports statistics and assisted with interviews of football coaches and players

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Working with a friend, owned and operated a full service car detailing business were we would pick the vehicle up from the owner's home and perform exterior and interior car detailing.
